headline: Autodesk Reports 17% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth in Fiscal Q3
summary: Autodesk reported third-quarter revenue of $2.16 billion, representing 17% growth year-over-year as reported and 14% on a constant currency basis.
why: Autodesk, Inc. is an American multinational software provider specializing in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software.

impacts.name: Autodesk
impacts.why: Double-digit revenue growth demonstrates robust demand for the company's enterprise software suite.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue expansion boosts investor sentiment around enterprise software spending.
